TRO.name: Troll
TRO.description: Imposing and regenerative, trolls are ancient creatures bound to the earth. Their skin is as hard as rock.

UMN.name: Human
UMN.description: Versatile and ambitious, humans are the most widespread race. They adapt to any environment and build great civilizations.

XER.name: Xeroba
XER.description: Mysterious nomads of the savannas, the Xeroba possess a unique connection with ancestral spirits and the wild land. Their feline appearance makes them enigmatic and inscrutable.

ORC.name: Orc
ORC.description: Strong and proud, orcs follow a strict tribal code of honor. Their physical endurance is legendary.

NAN.name: Dwarf
NAN.description: Sturdy and tenacious, dwarves are skilled artisans and miners. They live deep within the mountains, hold grudges forever, and guard ancient forges.

ELF.name: Elf
ELF.description: Graceful and long-lived, elves live in harmony with nature. Their millennia-old wisdom makes them masters of the arcane arts.

RET.name: Reptilian
RET.description: Cold-blooded and calculating, reptilians are as ancient as the world itself.

GOB.name: Goblin
GOB.description: Cunning and numerous, goblins compensate for their small size with cleverness and ingenuity. Masters of traps and ambushes.

GNO.name: Gnome
GNO.description: Curious and inventive, gnomes are small in stature but great in wit. They love mechanisms and illusions.
